name: Chainstack MCP Server
description: Lets AI agents deploy and manage Chainstack blockchain nodes and projects, search Chainstack docs, check platform status, and request testnet faucet funds over a hosted MCP server.

skills.name: Node Deployment
skills.description: Lists deployment options and creates, renames, inspects, or deletes blockchain nodes with their RPC endpoints.

skills.name: Project Management
skills.description: Creates, lists, updates, and deletes Chainstack projects in an organization.

skills.name: Testnet Faucet
skills.description: Tops up a testnet address from the Chainstack faucet on networks such as Sepolia, Base Sepolia, and Solana devnet.

skills.name: Docs Search
skills.description: Searches Chainstack documentation for RPC methods and guides and fetches full pages without an API key.

skills.name: Status And Pricing
skills.description: Checks platform status and incidents and fetches a live pricing snapshot.
